keyPoints.en: A nation-state (negara bangsa) is a sovereign country with its own government, territory, laws and loyal people who share an identity.
keyPoints.bm: Negara bangsa ialah negara berdaulat yang mempunyai kerajaan, wilayah, undang-undang dan rakyat yang taat setia serta berkongsi identiti.

keyPoints.en: Long before Western powers arrived, kingdoms of the Malay world (Alam Melayu) already had the features of a nation-state.
keyPoints.bm: Lama sebelum kuasa Barat datang, kerajaan di Alam Melayu sudah mempunyai ciri-ciri negara bangsa.

keyPoints.en: Examples: Funan, Champa, Srivijaya, Majapahit, Kedah Tua, Gangga Negara and Langkasuka.
keyPoints.bm: Contoh: Funan, Champa, Srivijaya, Majapahit, Kedah Tua, Gangga Negara dan Langkasuka.

keyPoints.en: Four features of these early kingdoms: a ruler (raja), laws (undang-undang), a territory of influence (wilayah pengaruh) and people (rakyat).
keyPoints.bm: Empat ciri kerajaan awal ini: raja, undang-undang, wilayah pengaruh dan rakyat.

meaning.en: A sovereign state whose loyal people share an identity under one government and territory.
meaning.bm: Negara berdaulat yang rakyatnya taat dan berkongsi identiti di bawah satu kerajaan dan wilayah.

meaning.en: The region of the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, Java, Borneo and nearby islands sharing Malay culture.
meaning.bm: Rantau Semenanjung Tanah Melayu, Sumatera, Jawa, Borneo dan pulau sekitarnya yang berkongsi budaya Melayu.

meaning.en: Areas that accepted a kingdom's power, often by sending tribute (ufti).
meaning.bm: Kawasan yang menerima kuasa sesebuah kerajaan, selalunya dengan menghantar ufti.

meaning.en: A stone carved with writing — key evidence of early laws and rulers.
meaning.bm: Batu yang diukir dengan tulisan — bukti penting undang-undang dan pemerintah awal.

points.en: The ruler was the centre of government and was seen as having special powers.
points.bm: Raja ialah pusat pemerintahan dan dianggap mempunyai kuasa luar biasa.

points.en: Srivijaya's Kedukan Bukit inscription (683 CE) names its ruler, Dapunta Hyang.
points.bm: Prasasti Kedukan Bukit (683 M) Srivijaya menyebut pemerintahnya, Dapunta Hyang.

points.en: Laws kept order and loyalty. The Kota Kapur inscription (686 CE) of Srivijaya curses anyone who rebels against the ruler.
points.bm: Undang-undang menjaga ketenteraman dan kesetiaan. Prasasti Kota Kapur (686 M) Srivijaya mengandungi sumpahan terhadap sesiapa yang menderhaka kepada raja.

points.en: Laws were based on custom (adat) and, later, religion.
points.bm: Undang-undang berasaskan adat dan, kemudiannya, agama.

points.en: Srivijaya controlled the Strait of Melaka and the Sunda Strait, the busiest sea routes.
points.bm: Srivijaya menguasai Selat Melaka dan Selat Sunda, laluan laut paling sibuk.

points.en: Majapahit's influence spread across much of the archipelago.
points.bm: Pengaruh Majapahit meliputi sebahagian besar kepulauan Melayu.

points.en: People were loyal to the ruler, paid tribute and served when called.
points.bm: Rakyat taat kepada raja, membayar ufti dan berkhidmat apabila diperlukan.

points.en: They shared the Malay language — Old Malay appears on Srivijaya's inscriptions.
points.bm: Mereka berkongsi bahasa Melayu — bahasa Melayu Kuno terdapat pada prasasti Srivijaya.

question.en: State TWO features of a nation-state in the early kingdoms of the Malay world.
question.bm: Nyatakan DUA ciri negara bangsa kerajaan awal di Alam Melayu.

answer.en: Any two: a ruler; laws; a territory of influence; loyal people. Give an example, e.g. Srivijaya ruled the Strait of Melaka.
answer.bm: Mana-mana dua: raja; undang-undang; wilayah pengaruh; rakyat yang taat. Beri contoh, cth. Srivijaya menguasai Selat Melaka.

tip.en: Remember the four features as R-U-W-R: Raja, Undang-undang, Wilayah, Rakyat.
tip.bm: Ingat empat ciri sebagai R-U-W-R: Raja, Undang-undang, Wilayah, Rakyat.

keyPoints.en: The Melaka Sultanate (founded c. 1400 by Parameswara) had all the features of a nation-state.
keyPoints.bm: Kesultanan Melayu Melaka (diasaskan sekitar 1400 oleh Parameswara) mempunyai semua ciri negara bangsa.

keyPoints.en: Six features: ruler, people, sovereignty, territory of influence, laws and symbols of royal greatness.
keyPoints.bm: Enam ciri: raja, rakyat, kedaulatan, wilayah pengaruh, undang-undang dan lambang kebesaran.

keyPoints.en: Melaka became a great port and a centre for spreading Islam and the Malay language.
keyPoints.bm: Melaka menjadi pelabuhan agung serta pusat penyebaran Islam dan bahasa Melayu.

meaning.en: The sacred authority of the ruler; opposing it is derhaka (treason).
meaning.bm: Kuasa luar biasa raja; menentangnya dianggap derhaka.

meaning.en: The pact between Sang Sapurba and Demang Lebar Daun: the ruler must not shame the people, the people must not betray the ruler.
meaning.bm: Perjanjian antara Sang Sapurba dengan Demang Lebar Daun: raja tidak boleh mengaibkan rakyat, rakyat tidak boleh menderhaka.

meaning.en: Melaka ruled itself freely and was recognised by other powers such as China.
meaning.bm: Melaka memerintah sendiri dengan bebas dan diiktiraf oleh kuasa lain seperti China.

meaning.en: Objects showing royal greatness, e.g. the nobat, royal keris and umbrella.
meaning.bm: Objek yang melambangkan kebesaran raja, cth. nobat, keris diraja dan payung.

meaning.en: A common language for people of different origins — Malay in Melaka.
meaning.bm: Bahasa perantaraan antara orang berlainan asal — bahasa Melayu di Melaka.

points.en: The Sultan was head of state, head of Islam and the source of authority, with daulat.
points.bm: Sultan ialah ketua negara, ketua agama Islam dan sumber kuasa, serta mempunyai daulat.

points.en: Sultan Muzaffar Syah (1445–1459) made Islam the official religion and was the first to use the title "Sultan".
points.bm: Sultan Muzaffar Syah (1445–1459) menjadikan Islam agama rasmi dan merupakan yang pertama menggunakan gelaran "Sultan".

points.en: People were loyal to the Sultan; they included the ruling class and the ruled (rakyat biasa, hamba).
points.bm: Rakyat taat setia kepada Sultan; terdiri daripada golongan pemerintah dan yang diperintah (rakyat biasa, hamba).

points.en: Traders from many lands lived in Melaka, making it a multi-ethnic port.
points.bm: Pedagang dari pelbagai negeri tinggal di Melaka, menjadikannya pelabuhan berbilang kaum.

points.en: Melaka made its own decisions and defended itself.
points.bm: Melaka membuat keputusan sendiri dan mempertahankan dirinya.

points.en: Ties with Ming China (e.g. Admiral Zheng He's visits from 1405) protected Melaka from Siam.
points.bm: Hubungan dengan China Ming (cth. lawatan Laksamana Cheng Ho sejak 1405) melindungi Melaka daripada Siam.

points.en: At its peak under Sultan Mansur Syah, Melaka's influence covered much of the Malay Peninsula and the east coast of Sumatra (e.g. Kampar, Siak, Inderagiri).
points.bm: Pada zaman kegemilangan di bawah Sultan Mansur Syah, pengaruh Melaka meliputi sebahagian besar Semenanjung Tanah Melayu dan pantai timur Sumatera (cth. Kampar, Siak, Inderagiri).

points.en: Written laws: Hukum Kanun Melaka (land) and Undang-undang Laut Melaka (sea).
points.bm: Undang-undang bertulis: Hukum Kanun Melaka (darat) dan Undang-undang Laut Melaka (laut).

points.en: Royal regalia such as the nobat (royal orchestra), cogan, royal keris and umbrellas; yellow was a royal colour that ordinary people could not use.
points.bm: Alat kebesaran diraja seperti nobat, cogan, keris diraja dan payung; warna kuning ialah warna larangan bagi rakyat biasa.

event.en: Zheng He's fleet first visits; ties with Ming China.
event.bm: Armada Cheng Ho mula melawat; hubungan dengan China Ming.

event.en: Sultan Muzaffar Syah: Islam the official religion.
event.bm: Sultan Muzaffar Syah: Islam agama rasmi.

event.en: Sultan Mansur Syah: Melaka at its height (Tun Perak as Bendahara).
event.bm: Sultan Mansur Syah: Melaka di puncak kegemilangan (Tun Perak sebagai Bendahara).

alt.bm: Replika istana Kesultanan Melayu Melaka, kini muzium di Melaka.

question.en: How did the waadat strengthen the Melaka Sultanate?
question.bm: Bagaimanakah waadat mengukuhkan Kesultanan Melayu Melaka?

answer.en: It set duties on both sides: the ruler would rule justly and not shame the people, and the people would stay loyal and not commit derhaka. This created trust and stability.
answer.bm: Waadat menetapkan tanggungjawab kedua-dua pihak: raja memerintah dengan adil dan tidak mengaibkan rakyat, manakala rakyat kekal taat dan tidak menderhaka. Ini mewujudkan kepercayaan dan kestabilan.

tip.en: For "ciri negara bangsa Melaka", list SIX: Raja, Rakyat, Kedaulatan, Wilayah pengaruh, Undang-undang, Lambang kebesaran — and give one fact for each.
tip.bm: Untuk "ciri negara bangsa Melaka", senaraikan ENAM: Raja, Rakyat, Kedaulatan, Wilayah pengaruh, Undang-undang, Lambang kebesaran — dan beri satu fakta bagi setiap satu.

keyPoints.en: Melaka was strong because of an organised system of officials (pembesar) under the Sultan.
keyPoints.bm: Melaka kukuh kerana sistem pembesar yang tersusun di bawah Sultan.

keyPoints.en: The Four Chiefs (Pembesar Empat Lipatan): Bendahara, Penghulu Bendahari, Temenggung and Laksamana.
keyPoints.bm: Pembesar Empat Lipatan: Bendahara, Penghulu Bendahari, Temenggung dan Laksamana.

keyPoints.en: Below them were the Pembesar Lapan, Enam Belas and Tiga Puluh Dua, plus four Syahbandar for foreign traders.
keyPoints.bm: Di bawahnya ialah Pembesar Lapan, Enam Belas dan Tiga Puluh Dua, serta empat orang Syahbandar untuk pedagang asing.

keyPoints.en: Two written codes: Hukum Kanun Melaka (land) and Undang-undang Laut Melaka (sea), based on Islamic law and adat.
keyPoints.bm: Dua kod bertulis: Hukum Kanun Melaka (darat) dan Undang-undang Laut Melaka (laut), berasaskan hukum Islam dan adat.

meaning.en: Chief minister: adviser to the Sultan, head of administration and chief judge; acted for the Sultan when needed.
meaning.bm: Ketua menteri: penasihat Sultan, ketua pentadbir dan ketua hakim; memangku Sultan jika perlu.

meaning.en: Head of the treasury and palace affairs; head of the Syahbandar.
meaning.bm: Ketua perbendaharaan dan urusan istana; ketua Syahbandar.

meaning.en: Head of police and internal security; looked after weights and measures in the market.
meaning.bm: Ketua polis dan keselamatan dalam negeri; mengawasi timbangan dan sukatan di pasar.

meaning.en: Head of the navy, the Sultan's bodyguard and envoy.
meaning.bm: Ketua angkatan laut, pengawal peribadi dan duta Sultan.

meaning.en: Port officials who looked after foreign traders by region of origin.
meaning.bm: Pegawai pelabuhan yang menguruskan pedagang asing mengikut kawasan asal.

meaning.en: Ship captain — under Undang-undang Laut Melaka, like a "king at sea".
meaning.bm: Ketua kapal — di bawah Undang-undang Laut Melaka, umpama "raja di laut".

points.en: Sultan at the top → Pembesar Empat → Pembesar Lapan → Pembesar Enam Belas → Pembesar Tiga Puluh Dua.
points.bm: Sultan di puncak → Pembesar Empat → Pembesar Lapan → Pembesar Enam Belas → Pembesar Tiga Puluh Dua.

points.en: Each Syahbandar handled traders from one group of regions (e.g. Gujerat; India and Burma; Java and the Malay islands; China and Champa).
points.bm: Setiap Syahbandar menguruskan pedagang dari satu kumpulan kawasan (cth. Gujerat; India dan Burma; Jawa dan kepulauan Melayu; China dan Champa).

points.en: The system made trade orderly and kept the port safe — so traders trusted Melaka.
points.bm: Sistem ini menjadikan perdagangan teratur dan pelabuhan selamat — maka pedagang mempercayai Melaka.

points.en: Crime (jenayah): punishments for theft, murder and other offences.
points.bm: Jenayah: hukuman bagi mencuri, membunuh dan kesalahan lain.

points.en: Role of the Sultan and chiefs: their rights and royal prohibitions (larangan diraja).
points.bm: Peranan Sultan dan pembesar: hak mereka dan larangan diraja.

points.en: Family: marriage, divorce and other family matters.
points.bm: Kekeluargaan: nikah, cerai dan hal keluarga lain.

points.en: Economy: buying and selling, weights and measures, debts.
points.bm: Ekonomi: jual beli, timbangan dan sukatan, hutang.

points.en: Role of the nakhoda: full authority on the ship.
points.bm: Peranan nakhoda: berkuasa penuh di atas kapal.

points.en: Sailing: duties of the crew and rules of the voyage.
points.bm: Pelayaran: tugas anak kapal dan peraturan pelayaran.

points.en: Crime at sea and punishments; taxes and trade rules.
points.bm: Jenayah di laut dan hukumannya; cukai dan peraturan berniaga.

question.en: Explain how the system of officials helped Melaka become a great port.
question.bm: Jelaskan bagaimana sistem pembesar membantu Melaka menjadi pelabuhan agung.

answer.en: Each official had clear duties: the Temenggung kept order and fair weights, the Laksamana guarded the seas from pirates, and the Syahbandar looked after foreign traders. Traders felt safe and treated fairly, so more came.
answer.bm: Setiap pembesar mempunyai tugas yang jelas: Temenggung menjaga keamanan dan timbangan yang adil, Laksamana mengawal perairan daripada lanun, dan Syahbandar menguruskan pedagang asing. Pedagang berasa selamat dan dilayan adil, maka lebih ramai datang.

tip.en: A common question asks you to match each of the Four Chiefs with a duty. Learn ONE main duty for each first.
tip.bm: Soalan lazim meminta anda memadankan Pembesar Empat dengan tugasnya. Hafal SATU tugas utama bagi setiap satu dahulu.

keyPoints.en: Government worked because rulers and people each played their role.
keyPoints.bm: Pemerintahan berjalan lancar kerana pemerintah dan rakyat memainkan peranan masing-masing.

keyPoints.en: The Sultan and chiefs ruled, protected the people and upheld Islam and adat.
keyPoints.bm: Sultan dan pembesar memerintah, melindungi rakyat serta menjaga Islam dan adat.

keyPoints.en: The people were loyal, paid taxes, did kerah (unpaid labour for the state) and defended the kingdom.
keyPoints.bm: Rakyat taat setia, membayar cukai, melakukan kerah dan mempertahankan negeri.

meaning.en: Full loyalty of the people to the ruler — the base of stability.
meaning.bm: Kesetiaan penuh rakyat kepada raja — asas kestabilan.

meaning.en: Labour the people gave to the ruler, e.g. building forts, roads and palaces.
meaning.bm: Tenaga kerja yang diberikan rakyat kepada raja, cth. membina kubu, jalan dan istana.

meaning.en: Treason against the ruler — a very serious offence.
meaning.bm: Menentang raja — kesalahan yang amat berat.

heading.en: Role of the Sultan and chiefs

points.en: The Sultan: head of state and of Islam, source of law, symbol of unity, protector of the people.
points.bm: Sultan: ketua negara dan agama Islam, sumber undang-undang, lambang perpaduan, pelindung rakyat.

points.en: Chiefs: ran the administration, kept order in their districts and collected taxes for the Sultan.
points.bm: Pembesar: menjalankan pentadbiran, menjaga keamanan di daerah masing-masing dan memungut cukai untuk Sultan.

points.en: Stayed loyal and obeyed the laws.
points.bm: Kekal taat setia dan mematuhi undang-undang.

points.en: Paid taxes and gave kerah labour; went to war when called.
points.bm: Membayar cukai dan memberikan tenaga kerah; turut berperang apabila diperlukan.

points.en: Farmed, fished and traded, keeping the economy going.
points.bm: Bertani, menangkap ikan dan berdagang, menggerakkan ekonomi.

question.en: Why was the relationship between ruler and people important to the Melaka Sultanate?
question.bm: Mengapakah hubungan antara pemerintah dengan rakyat penting kepada Kesultanan Melayu Melaka?

answer.en: A just ruler and loyal people kept the kingdom stable and united, so it could defend itself, keep order and grow rich through trade.
answer.bm: Pemerintah yang adil dan rakyat yang taat menjadikan kerajaan stabil dan bersatu, maka ia dapat mempertahankan diri, menjaga keamanan dan menjadi makmur melalui perdagangan.

tip.en: Link this to today: loyalty to King and Country is the second Rukun Negara principle.
tip.bm: Kaitkan dengan masa kini: Kesetiaan kepada Raja dan Negara ialah prinsip kedua Rukun Negara.
